patterns: APPSC asks single facts on the revolt's end: Bahadur Shah exiled to Rangoon, Bakht Khan came from Bareilly, odd-one-out leader not linked to 1857 (Bhagat Singh).

Other PSCs ask officers killed at Lucknow (Lawrence, Neill, Havelock; not Nicholson), Tantia Tope betrayed and executed, Rani's last battle against Hugh Rose, and statement sets on reasons for failure.
Trap pattern: Delhi retaken by Nicholson's assault, not Campbell; Henry Lawrence died defending Lucknow.
App MCQs match PYQ depth well and add AP angle (Nizam and Salar Jung loyal, Hyderabad Residency attack).
